messages.redAlert: {organisation} has raised a Red-level blue-green algae alert for {siteName} ({biovolume} mm³/L, {genus} dominant). Please issue public warnings: avoid contact and find an alternative water source.
messages.forecastRed: {organisation} forecasts a likely Red-level blue-green algae alert for the {river} at {siteName}{when}. The site is currently {tierNow} ({biovolume} mm³/L, {genus} dominant). We recommend preparing public advice for recreational and other water users. We'll confirm with the next lab result.
messages.amberAlert: Amber-level blue-green algae alert for {siteName} ({biovolume} mm³/L, {genus} dominant). Recommend increased sampling and preparing public advice.

tierGuidance.Amber: Medium. Increase sampling and tell the council.
tierGuidance.Red: High. Council warns the public: avoid contact, find another water source.
